learning_objective: 🎯 You will learn how to build a perfect paragraph like a tasty burger, and how to write a secret diary entry to record your daily adventures!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A good paragraph is like a burger! The top bun is the 'Topic Sentence' that introduces the main idea. The meat and veggies inside are the 'Supporting Details'. The bottom bun is the 'Concluding Sentence' that wraps it up nicely!
A diary is your personal, secret friend! You write in it to record your feelings, secrets, and the events of your day. We always write diary entries in the first person using 'I' and 'we'.

A diary entry has a special format! You must start with the Date, Day, and Time at the top left. Then you greet your diary by writing 'Dear Diary,'. After writing your feelings in the body, you sign your name at the bottom!

fun_activity.title: ✍️ My Secret Diary Moment
fun_activity.instructions: Pretend you just met your favourite cartoon character! Write a short, proper diary entry including the date, time, 'Dear Diary,' and three sentences about how excited you are.

quick_recap: ⭐ A paragraph focuses on one main idea and contains a topic sentence, details, and a conclusion.
⭐ A diary entry is a personal record of daily events and feelings written in the first person.
⭐ Always include the date, day, time, and a greeting like 'Dear Diary' before writing your entry.
